description: Conformance profile for Nepal-facing ERP, accounting, payroll, and compliance workflows that handle BS/AD dates.
target_workflows: future BS review and source-status handling

checks.description: Compare duplicated frontend and backend BS month tables when a project stores both.
Check BS month day counts for reported public mismatch rows where exact values are available.
Check BS/AD conversion boundaries and roundtrip-sensitive dates.
Reject impossible BS dates instead of accepting malformed or out-of-range day/month combinations.
Classify BS/AD fiscal year edges with explicit boundary handling.
Flag payroll periods whose BS month duration is reported or computed inconsistently.
Keep future BS data behind review-needed/source-status boundaries when public issue evidence shows uncertainty.
Reserved for source-backed holiday and working-day fixtures when public data is represented.

authority_boundary: This profile is decision-support and conformance-test guidance only; it is not government, legal, tax, payroll, banking, or official calendar authority.
